name: climate
title: Climate event and extremes profile
description: Media documenting drought, heat, flood, storm, or other climate-attributed events. Attribution context comes from contextJoins to reanalysis or index products.
notes: A photo of a dry reservoir is evidence of a condition. A 30-year rainfall deficit is an ERA5 (or equivalent) join, stored separately.
Present a context join as a retrieved value. Legal or scientific attribution needs the source dataset and method to support that claim.
